title: Stop Adventure Sports in India...
description:
Bungee jumping, paragliding, river rafting adventure sports in India look thrilling on Instagram, but the reality is terrifying. Poor safety standards, untrained operators, outdated equipment, and zero accountability have turned “adventure” into a gamble with life.

There are no strict regulations, no proper audits, and when accidents happen, blame is quietly buried. From rope failures to weather negligence, lives are lost while operators walk free.

In this video, we expose why adventure sports in India are dangerously unregulated and why your thrill might cost you your life.
